name: 2FA
author: Sasiru Ravihansa
description: TOTP authenticator for omarchy-shell. Live two-factor codes in the bar, secrets in your keyring, enrolment by scanning the QR code straight off the screen. Fully offline.

barWidget.description: Two-factor codes, generated locally from secrets held in your keyring

schema.label: YubiKey accounts
schema.description: Also show codes from OATH accounts on an inserted YubiKey. The key is only read while this is on; nothing is imported or stored.
